sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Cleaner is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "You know, I have foreign partners who are working on evacuating important assets from Tarkov. They are especially interested in Reserve and the laboratory beneath the city. But recently, they have encountered some competition... Can you help and eliminate these obstacles?"

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text:
- Must reach Loyalty Level 3 with Peacekeeper to obtain this quest.
- Must complete 4 Loyalty Level 3 quests from Peacekeeper to obtain this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Eliminate 10 Raiders or Black Division operatives on Reserve or The Lab

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- Peacekeeper Rep +0.75
- 1,900 Euros
  - 1,995 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 2,185 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 4× Power supply unit
- Unlocks purchase of 7.62x51mm M80 at Peacekeeper LL4
"Excellent work! Now my partners will be able to operate on these locations much more easily."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text: Scav Raiders may sometimes be found in the command area of the underground tunnel system at the start of a raid, and additional ones may appear after the "D-2" extraction power switch has been activated. The arrival of the train may also spawn them at the train yard. Additionally, pulling the "Bunker hermetic door" extraction lever may spawn them at the train yard.
